newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aerodata in talks to buy UK firm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aerodata in talks to buy UK firm.

text.p: Airborne minerals exploration firm Aerodata Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was in talks to buy all the shares in British technical advisory firm Scott Pickford Plc.

Aerodata said Scott Pickford had annual turnover in the year to March 31, 1996 of about A$18 million and after tax profit of A$650,000. Scott Pickford provides technical advice and management services to the petroleum industry in the fields of geology, geophysics and other geoscience areas.
"Preliminary negotiations have commenced whereby Aerodata may make an offer for a minimum 50.1 percent of Scott Pickford," Aerodata said.
Aerodata's shares were down two cents at A$1.17 at 10.30 am (2330 GMT). Scott Pickford shares last traded on October 31 at 35 pence. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
